name: Laredo (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and light blue, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Laredo (a ship and a tower on blue, inscribed ARMAS DE LA VILLA DE LAREDO).
history: The council has a flag and municipal arms; the flag is formed of three horizontal stripes of equal width, green above, white in the centre and light blue below.

features.role: Laredo arms — ship and tower on blue, inscribed
